kind: bug / Graph / Python builtin / Tensor iterator
title: Graph mode rejects map(lambda, Tensor) even though Tensor iteration and map over Tensor-row tuples work
duplicate_search_queries: "Map can only be applied to list, tuple, but got Tensor" "MindSpore"
site:gitee.com/mindspore/mindspore "Map can only be applied to list, tuple" "Tensor"
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 static graph syntax documentation lists map as a supported Python built-in and describes its use as similar to Python.
Python map accepts an iterable. In this environment, Tensor is iterable in PyNative mode and in Graph controls such as zip(Tensor, Tensor), sum(Tensor), and for iteration.
Graph map over a tuple of Tensor rows works, so the lambda body and Tensor row operation are supported.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the failure is a Graph compile-time termination mismatch.
Not a CPU kernel issue: no backend kernel is reached; tuple-map and Tensor-zip controls run on CPU.
Distinct from MS-020: this does not involve next() returning iterator internals.
Distinct from MS-022: this is map rejecting Tensor as an input sequence, while MS-022 is filter failing when the predicate returns a scalar Tensor bool.
